Slough Skin.name: Slough Skin
Slough Skin.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The cave worm would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dN8QBNuTiaBHCKUe]{Cursed Metamorphosis})

Effect The cave worm negates the triggering condition or effect by sloughing an outer layer of its skin. Effects from artifacts, deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way.

Cave Worm Venom.name: Cave Worm Venom
Cave Worm Venom.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage, and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Fast Swallow.name: Fast Swallow
Fast Swallow.description:
Trigger The cave worm @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabs} a creature.

Effect The worm uses Swallow Whole.

crXV18abZr2DcEh8.name: Regurgitate
crXV18abZr2DcEh8.description:
The purple worm can violently regurgitate a creature or boulder it has swallowed to make a ranged Strike. The Strike deals bludgeoning damage depending on the size of the projectile:

  • Tiny @Damage[(2d6+13)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+13}
  • Small @Damage[(3d6+13)[bludgeoning]]{3d6+13}
  • Medium @Damage[(4d6+13)[bludgeoning]]{4d6+13}
  • Large @Damage[(5d6+13)[bludgeoning]]{5d6+13}
  • Huge @Damage[(6d6+13)[bludgeoning]]{6d6+13}

A regurgitated creature takes falling damage from the height of the target or from 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Boulders occupy space in the worm's stomach as a creature of equivalent size, and purple worms often have several boulders swallowed. A purple worm can use a single action to swallow a new boulder.

@UUID[Macro.X28HKDQaNJxl4fci]{Regurgitate Animation}

Rock Tunneler.name: Rock Tunneler
Rock Tunneler.description: A cave worm can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does.

Thrash.name: Thrash
Thrash.description: The worm makes a Strike once against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws, up to once with its stinger, and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the worm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.

(Ghost) Site Bound.name: (Ghost) Site Bound
(Ghost) Site Bound.description: A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

(Ghost) Rejuvenation.name: (Ghost) Rejuvenation
(Ghost) Rejuvenation.description: When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Ghost Queen's Reflection.name: Ghost Queen's Reflection
Ghost Queen's Reflection.disable:
The haunt can be disabled in one of three ways:

  • Four @Check[religion|dc:21] (trained) checks to banish the spectral image of Belcorra.

  • Two @Check[deception|dc:26] (trained) checks to goad this shard, which is infused with a minute portion of Belcorra's essence, into a fury, shattering its focus.

  • One @Check[athletics|dc:31] (expert) check to smash the mirror's magical structure, permanently shattering it.
Ghost Queen's Reflection.hazarddescription: The reflection in the mirror subtly twists and distorts, its expression taking on an unnerving sneer of malice. It is the image of a beautiful but cruel-looking woman with blood-flecked lips and hands that look closer to claws.
Ghost Queen's Reflection.reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 minute unless it has been disabled.
Ghost Queen's Reflection.routine:
(2 actions)

The haunt uses the Become The Experiment action.

Spectral Impale.name: Spectral Impale
Spectral Impale.description:
Trigger A living creature steps into any square that is directly in line with the mirror or adjacent to it.

Effect Shadowy tendrils impale the body of the creature as the haunt makes a blood sample Strike.

Sap Vitality.name: Sap Vitality
Sap Vitality.description: A creature hit by the reflection's blood sample must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save as the haunt tries to draw a portion of its vital essence into the mirror. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} on a failed saving throw, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure.

Become The Experiment.name: Become The Experiment
Become The Experiment.description:
Effect The image of the Ghost Queen, Belcorra, whispers in your mind, compelling you to submit to the experiments of her servants. The haunt deals @Damage[(2d10+9)[mental]] damage to a single non-unholy creature in the room. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature takes full damage, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, and gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition for 1 round, driven to take one of the ladders down the east hatch.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. It also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} and gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition for 1 minute, driven to take one of the ladders down the east hatch.

Horrifying Visage.name: Horrifying Visage
Horrifying Visage.description:
Requirements The will-o'-wisp swarm is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible}

Effect The will-o'-wisp swarm reveals itself, losing its invisibility for 1 round. Each creature within @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] must make a @Check[will|dc:26] save.

Regardless of their result, the targets become immune to Horrifying Visage for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
Failure The creature takes @Damage[5d8[mental]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d8[mental]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Shocking Swarm.name: Shocking Swarm
Shocking Swarm.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[5d6[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic:true] save).

Feed on Fear.name: Feed on Fear
Feed on Fear.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements An enemy within 30 feet is under a fear effect or dying

Effect The will-o'-wisp feeds on the creature's terror. It regains @Damage[4d4[healing]]{4d4 Hit Points}, and if it has Gone Dark, its glow reignites.

Go Dark.name: Go Dark
Go Dark.description: The will-o'-wisp extinguishes its glow, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. It can end this effect with another use of this action. If it uses its Shocking Swarm while invisible, the arcs of electricity lets any observer determine its location, making the will-o'-wisp only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to all observers until it moves.

Glow.name: Glow
Glow.description:
40 feet.

A will-o'-wisp is itself naturally invisible, but glows with a colored light, casting bright light in the aura and making it visible.

Magic Immunity.name: Magic Immunity
Magic Immunity.description: A will-o'-wisp swarm is immune to all spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}.

Nhimbaloth Cult Leader.name: Nhimbaloth Cult Leader
Nhimbaloth Cult Leader.publicNotes:
A career of mystical accomplishments combined with a lifetime of subterfuge and intimidation has elevated this occultist to a powerful position.

Hidden secrets and occult powers have an irresistible lure for many. Since the majority of these NPCs are spellcasters, consider using alternative spell lists to adjust their themes.

Honeyed Words.name: Honeyed Words
Honeyed Words.description:
Falsehoods pass your lips as smoothly as silk. You gain a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} and against Perception checks to discern if you are telling the truth, and you add your level even if untrained. If the implausibility of your lies prompts a circumstance penalty or a DC increase, reduce that penalty by half or increase it by half.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.6vodhSeI3ClMfOGd]{Spell Effect: Honeyed Words}

Outcast's Curse.name: Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Suggestion.name: Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Enthrall.name: Enthrall
Enthrall.description:
Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

Mind Reading.name: Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Calm.name: Calm
Calm.description:
You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

Laughing Fit.name: Laughing Fit
Laughing Fit.description:
The target is overtaken with uncontrollable laughter. It must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is plagued with uncontrollable laughter. It can't use reactions.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and can't use actions or reactions for 1 round. It then takes the effects of a failure.

Stupefy.name: Stupefy
Stupefy.description:
You dull the target's mind, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.

Bless.name: Bless
Bless.description:
Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet.

Bless can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{Aura: Bless}

Daze.name: Daze
Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Grim Tendrils.name: Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Guidance.name: Guidance
Guidance.description:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

Illusory Disguise.name: Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Lock.name: Lock
Lock.description:
The target's latch mechanism clinks shut, held fast by unseen magical wards. When you magically lock a target, you set an Athletics and Thievery DC to open it equal to your spell DC or the base lock DC with a +4 status bonus, whichever is higher. Any key or combination that once opened a lock affected by this spell does not do so for the duration of the spell, though the key or combination does grant a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to open the door. If the target is opened, the spell ends. Assuming the target is not barred or locked in some additional way, you can unlock and open it with an Interact action during which you touch the target. This does not end the spell. You can Dismiss this spell at any time and from any distance.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is unlimited, but you must expend 6 gp worth of precious metals as an additional cost.

Phantasmal Minion.name: Phantasmal Minion
Phantasmal Minion.description: You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.j7NNPfZwD19BwSEZ]{Phantasmal Minion}. The minion is roughly the shape of a humanoid. You can choose to have it be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} or have an ephemeral appearance, but it's obviously a magical effect, not a real creature.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Void Warp.name: Void Warp
Void Warp.description:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Ceremonial Robes.name: Ceremonial Robes
Ceremonial Robes.description: Explorer's clothing is sturdy enough that it can be reinforced to protect you, even though it isn't a suit of armor. It comes in many forms, though the most common sorts look like clerical vestments, monk's garments, or wizard's robes, as members of all three classes are likely to avoid wearing armor.

Indecipherable Book of Sigils (Spellbook.name: Indecipherable Book of Sigils (Spellbook)
Indecipherable Book of Sigils (Spellbook.description: A spellbook holds the written knowledge necessary to learn and prepare various spells, a necessity for wizards (who typically get one for free) and a useful luxury for other spellcasters looking to learn additional spells. Each spellbook can hold up to 100 spells. The Price listed is for a blank spellbook.

Protect the Master!.name: Protect the Master!
Protect the Master!.description:
Trigger The cult leader is targeted with an attack, and a lower-ranking cultist is adjacent to them

Effect The cult leader orders their cultist to leap in front of the attack. The cultist and cult leader swap places, and the cultist becomes the target of the attack. If the cultist has Fanatical Frenzy or a similar ability, they can activate it as a reaction if they take damage from the triggering attack.

Gather Converts.name: Gather Converts
Gather Converts.description:
With a short emotional phrase, the cult leader tries to sway the public to do their bidding. The cult leader tries to convince up to four bystanders in a crowd to cause a commotion, turn against a person or group, leave the area, protect the cult leader, or calm down. The cult leader attempts a single @Check[deception|against:perception] check against the highest Perception DC among the targets.

Critical Success The targets believe the lie and act as directed for 1 minute. Additionally, one bystander remains by the cult leader's side, influenced enough to join the cult. All other targets become wise to the cult leader after 1 minute, at which point their attitude toward the leader worsens by one step.

Success As a critical success, but no bystander joins the cult permanently.

Critical Failure The crowd is unmoved and unamused, and their attitude toward the cult leader worsens by one step.

Cult Lore (applies to the leader's own c.name: Cult Lore (applies to the leader's own cult)

Flail.name: Flail
Flail.description: This weapon consists of a wooden handle attached to a spiked ball or cylinder by a chain, rope, or strap of leather.

Fearful Feast.name: Fearful Feast
Fearful Feast.description:
Trigger A creature within range becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}

You open your mouth wide and inhale sharply; you draw in the bravery, self-confidence, and hope to which the frightened target clings and then strip away the target's false assumption that these fragile emotions can save them from the oblivion of terror. You deal 6d4 mental damage to the creature, which must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage; you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage the target takes.

Critical Failure The creature's frightened condition increases by 1 (to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}) and it takes double damage; you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage the target takes.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Lift Nature's Caul.name: Lift Nature's Caul
Lift Nature's Caul.description:
With a wave of the hand, you cause all creatures in the area to see the world around them as if a gauzy film had been lifted away to expose the truth that lies below their perceived reality. Natural features they can see grow twisted and horrendous, structures appear distorted and ruined, and objects seem warped and alien. This alternate vision fades quickly, but the glimpse beyond the natural world lingers for the spell's duration.

Aberrations or worshippers of Outer Gods or Great Old Ones are bolstered by this vision of warped reality and gain a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws and attack rolls for 1 minute, while all other creatures must attempt a Will saving throw.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ihv1azg80N3kj7Vo]{Spell Effect: Lift Nature's Caul (Bonus)}

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. It can't reduce the value of its frightened condition below 1 as long as it remains stupefied by this spell.

Heightened (+2) The area increases by 5 feet.

Blood Vendetta.name: Blood Vendetta
Blood Vendetta.description:
Requirements You can bleed.

Trigger A creature deals piercing, slashing, or persistent bleed damage to you.

You curse the target, punishing it for having the audacity to spill your blood. The target takes 2d6 persistent bleed damage and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half the persistent bleed damage.

Failure The target takes the full persistent bleed damage. Until the bleeding stops, the target has weakness 1 to piercing and slashing damage. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.buXx8Azr4BYWPtFg]{Spell Effect: Blood Vendetta (Failure)}

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double the persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+2) The persistent bleed damage increases by 2d6.

Fear.name: Fear
Fear.description:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Nhimbaloth Cultist.name: Nhimbaloth Cultist
Nhimbaloth Cultist.publicNotes: Hidden secrets and occult powers have an irresistible lure for many. Since the majority of these NPCs are spellcasters, consider using alternative spell lists to adjust their themes.
Nhimbaloth Cultist.allSaves: (Will +2 vs. higher-ranking members of the cult)

Cultist Garb (Functions as Leather Armor.name: Cultist Garb (Functions as Leather Armor)
Cultist Garb (Functions as Leather Armor.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Will +2 vs. Higher Ranking Members of th.name: Will +2 vs. Higher Ranking Members of the Cult

Fanatical Frenzy.name: Fanatical Frenzy
Fanatical Frenzy.description:
Requirements The cultist has taken damage and is neither @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} nor already in a frenzy

Effect The cultist flies into a frenzy that lasts 1 minute. While frenzied, the cultist gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls, and they take a –2 penalty to AC. The cultist can't voluntarily stop their frenzy. After their frenzy, the cultist is fatigued.

Cult Lore (for the cultist's own cult).name: Cult Lore (for the cultist's own cult)

Improvised Flail.name: Improvised Flail
Improvised Flail.description: This weapon consists of a wooden handle attached to a spiked ball or cylinder by a chain, rope, or strap of leather and appears to be of shoddy make.

Nhimbaloth Hunter.name: Nhimbaloth Hunter
Nhimbaloth Hunter.publicNotes:
These Nhimbaloth "Hunters" have grown past the minor pursuits of other hunters and they seek the most dangerous game, men. They hunt car nviores who have recently eaten a meat

Modified from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.3qDYEHtyAobpCg5r]{Monster Hunter}

Composite Longbow.name: Composite Longbow
Composite Longbow.description: This projectile weapon is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Like all longbows, its great size also increases the bow's range and power. You must use two hands to fire it, and it cannot be used while mounted. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a longbow, such as Erastil's favored weapon, it also applies to composite longbows unless otherwise stated.

Hide Armor.name: Hide Armor
Hide Armor.description: A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

Arrows.name: Arrows
Arrows.description: These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Favored Game.name: Favored Game
Favored Game.description: A monster hunter specializes in bringing down certain creatures. These favored game are those that have recently eaten meat in the last few hours.

Reactive Strike.name: Reactive Strike
Reactive Strike.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Hunter's Onslaught.name: Hunter's Onslaught
Hunter's Onslaught.description:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements The monster hunter isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}

Effect The monster hunter leads an attack against their monstrous foe. The monster hunter chooses an enemy they can see that qualifies as their favored game. The monster hunter becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by that creature and gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last as long as the onslaught does. During the onslaught, the hunter gains a +8 status bonus to damage rolls against the designated enemy, and allies in a 30-foot aura around the hunter gain half that bonus. The onslaught lasts for 1 minute or until either the nhimbaloth hunter or the designated creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

Primal Fear.name: Primal Fear
Primal Fear.description: When the monster hunter hits a creature that qualifies as their favored game, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit).

Sudden Charge.name: Sudden Charge
Sudden Charge.description: The monster hunter Strides twice and makes a melee Strike.

War Flail.name: War Flail
War Flail.description: This large flail has a long shaft connected to a shorter piece of stout wood or metal that's sometimes inlaid with spikes.

Carnivoresight.name: Carnivoresight
Carnivoresight.description: A Nhimbaloth Hunter automatically knows wheter a creature it sees qualifies as its Favored Game, and has a +4 status bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} them.

Religious Symbol (Wooden).name: Religious Symbol (Wooden)
Religious Symbol (Wooden).description: This piece of wood or silver is emblazoned with an image representing a deity. Some divine spellcasters, such as clerics, can use a religious symbol of their deity to use certain abilities and cast some spells. A religious symbol can be worn on the body on a chain or pin, or can be held.

Eyes of the Ghost Queen.name: Eyes of the Ghost Queen
Eyes of the Ghost Queen.disable: @Check[type:deception|dc:30|name:Cheat Her Sight] (expert) twice to confound the wisp eyes with your own deceptions; two wisps are destroyed on each successful check. Alternatively, @Check[type:occultism|dc:28|name:Steel Your Mind] (expert) four times to create a ward against the haunt's mental influence; one wisp is destroyed on each successful check.
Eyes of the Ghost Queen.hazarddescription: The ongoing effect of investigating the machinations of Nhimbaloth and her servants moves from the realm of sleep to your waking moments. Ominous cracks in the fabric of reality appear before your eyes, fraying the edges of your sanity. You are no longer certain of who your friends are. Allies appear to shed their disguises and reveal themselves to be malevolent monsters.
Eyes of the Ghost Queen.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.
Eyes of the Ghost Queen.routine: (4 actions) For each action available, the haunt targets a creature with the Whispers of Betrayal ability. When a wisp is destroyed, reduce the number of actions for the routine by 1.

Unmask Evil.name: Unmask Evil
Unmask Evil.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures enter the haunt's area

Effect Each creature sees the forms of nearby creatures shift and change, appearing to transform into fiendish or aberrant beings with a thirst for blood. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:33] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature sees through the illusions entirely and is temporarily immune to the haunt's actions for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected by the strange images.

Failure The creature believes the illusions to be true; when an action from the haunt inflicts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, they do not attempt flat checks toe end the confused condition when they take damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is left with a lingering suspicion of others and can't benefit from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} action for 24 hours.

Whispers of Betrayal.name: Whispers of Betrayal
Whispers of Betrayal.description:
The haunt continues to confound victims' senses and inspire them to commit violence against each other.

Target a creature in the haunt's area dealing @Damage[(2d12+15)[void]] Damage on a @Check[type:will|dc:30|showDC:all]{basic Will save}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and is targeted by the Your Lot, To Die curse.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute and is targeted by the Your Lot, To Die curse.

Grasp of the Ghost Queen.name: Grasp of the Ghost Queen
Grasp of the Ghost Queen.disable: @Check[type:intimidation|dc:35|name:Return Her Gaze] (expert) twice to impose your will on the wisp eyes; two wisps are destroyed on each successful check. Alternatively, @Check[type:occultism|dc:32|name:Steel Your Mind] (master) four times to create a ward against the haunt's mental influence; one wisp is destroyed on each successful check.
Grasp of the Ghost Queen.hazarddescription: The ongoing effect of investigating the machinations of Nhimbaloth and her servants moves from the realm of sleep to your waking moments. Ominous cracks in the fabric of reality appear before your eyes, fraying the edges of your sanity. You are no longer certain of who your friends are. Allies appear to shed their disguises and reveal themselves to be malevolent monsters.
Grasp of the Ghost Queen.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.
Grasp of the Ghost Queen.routine: (4 actions) For each action available, the haunt targets a creature with the Betrayal's Grasp ability. When a wisp is destroyed, reduce the number of actions for the routine by 1.

Seize Control.name: Seize Control
Seize Control.description:
The haunt is quick to react when creatures enter its range.

Trigger Two or more creatures enter the haunt's area

Effect Each creature sees the forms of nearby creatures shift and change, appearing to transform into fiendish or aberrant beings with a thirst for blood. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:35] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Success The creature is unaffected by the strange images.

Failure The creature feels that death is close at hand and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours.

Betrayal's Grasp.name: Betrayal's Grasp
Betrayal's Grasp.description:
The haunt continues to confound victims’ senses and inspire them to commit violence against each other.

Target 1 creature in the haunt's area

Save @Check[type:will|dc:32|showDC:all]{basic Will save}

Damage @Damage[(3d10+14)[void]]{3d10+14 void damage}

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} for 1 round and is exposed to the Your Lot, To Die curse.

Critical Failure The creature is controlled for 1 minute and is exposed to the Your Lot, To Die curse.

Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death.name: Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death
Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death.tokenName: Murmur, Implement of the Empty Death
Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death.disable: This haunt can only be disabled by performing three sequential checks.
Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death.hazarddescription:
When an occult spellcaster of the Empty Death seeks to give any type of regenerative ability to a particularly powerful and resource-intensive void creation (an ongoing spell, a complex hazard, or even a creature), they sometimes elect to use a separate implement to achieve this end. This implement draws void energy from the River of Souls, where the Empty Death hunts, funneling and amplifying that energy to a specific place on the mortal plane. The void energy can then be used to power the spellcaster's creation (or creations). While an object imbued with occult power makes for an adequate implement, a living creature used in this way generates a purer form of void energy as well as more consistent output. However, most beings, even those with no conscience, will refuse to use a living creature for such experiments, knowing that to do so would be to condemn that creature to an eternal life of unimaginable pain.

Unfortunately, those who serve the Empty Death — an inscrutable, malevolent Elder God with neither edicts nor anathemas — have no such scruples. These spellcasters are perfectly willing to capture and enslave a sentient creature to achieve their macabre goals. Many even take obscene delight in the process, which, among other things, involves permanently inflicting the feeblemind condition on the creature to domesticate and control it, scraping every ounce of soul energy from its mortal shell, and cruelly reshaping that soul energy to withstand the continual agony of serving as a living void energy source. Through a final series of unspeakable experiments, the spellcaster then consigns part of the creature's soul essence to the River of Souls while imprisoning the other part of the soul to a specific location on the material plane. The resulting abomination is known as an implement of the Empty Death, a tortured soul used as a living conduit between the Empty Death's plane and the mortal realm.

Sometimes known as a pale thrall, an implement of the Empty Death lives a life of perpetual, horrendous torment, possessing barely a spark of intelligence beyond the level of an average, nonmagical animal. At times, the implement's former life returns to them in vague, fragmented flashes of memory, but they can do nothing with these images. Indeed, they are incapable of speech beyond the simplest of words, which frequently takes the form of a plea to be killed and thereby released from their eternal suffering.

Implements of the Empty Death typically retain most or all of the abilities they had before their enslavement, though their creators will sometimes modify, augment, or add abilities to help the implement defend itself.
Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death.reset:
If there are no creatures within its Petrifying Gaze aura at the start of its turn, the haunt spends 1 action to emit a shrill scream that alerts its creator to the presence of intruders. It then uses an action to shut and lock the door and resets.

Disabling this haunt permanently destroys it, and the imprisoned creature dies.
Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death.routine: (4 actions; occult, spirit, void) The haunt uses its first two actions to make Snake Fangs melee Strikes against any creature in range. It uses its remaining two actions to Focus Gaze on any creatures within its Petrifying Gaze aura, prioritizing creatures who have already failed to save against Petrifying Gaze.
Murmur, The Implement of Empty Death.prototypeToken: Murmur, Implement of the Empty Death

Serpent Venom.name: Serpent Venom
Serpent Venom.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Biting Snakes.name: Biting Snakes
Biting Snakes.description:
Trigger A creature ends its movement adjacent to the haunt.

Effect The haunt makes a snake fangs Strike against the creature. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Petrifying Gaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
Petrifying Gaze.description: 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save. If the creature fails, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute. The haunt can deactivate or activate this aura by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Focus Gaze.name: Focus Gaze
Focus Gaze.description:
The haunt fixes their glare at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save against the haunt's petrifying gaze. The haunt's gaze is unaffected by walls or other nonmagical barriers.

If the creature was already slowed by petrifying gaze before attempting its save, a failed save causes it to be petrified permanently. After attempting its save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the haunt's next turn.

Ysondkhelir, Nightmare Addict.name: Ysondkhelir, Nightmare Addict
Ysondkhelir, Nightmare Addict.publicNotes:
Slavers and raiders from the cold, windswept dimension of Leng, these malevolent humanoids range across reality in ominous black ships capable of sailing beyond the borders of dimensions and planes. Although most denizens of Leng seek slaves and plunder like any pirate, others operate as self-styled ambassadors and merchants, sowing discord with far-ranging plots. While the inscrutable denizens dress themselves in flowing robes, veils, and broad turbans to appear human, their aberrant physiology, when glimpsed, is evident from their crown of stubby horns and tentacled jaws to their furry, goat-like legs.

Above the fierce captains who command the infamous black ships are an even higher caste of denizens of Leng. These cultists and musicians serve as high priests, laboring to appease the frightening gods who look down upon the Nightmare Realm with cold malice.

Outcast's Curse.name: Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Truespeech (Constant).name: Truespeech (Constant)
Truespeech (Constant).description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Hypnotic Pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
Hypnotic Pattern.description:
You create a pattern of shifting colors that hovers in the air in a geometric cloud. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while inside the pattern. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it is inside the pattern when you cast it, when it enters the pattern, when it ends its turn within the pattern, or if it uses a Seek or Interact action on the pattern. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the pattern doesn't attempt new saves.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is Fascinated by the pattern.

Critical Failure The target is Fascinated by the pattern. While it remains Fascinated, it can't use reactions.

Locate.name: Locate
Locate.description:
You learn the direction to the target (if you picked a specific object, such as "my mother's sword") or the nearest target (if you picked a type of object, such as "swords"). If the target is a specific object, you must have observed it directly with your own senses. If it's a type of object, you still need to have an accurate mental image of the type of object. If there's lead or running water between you and the target, this spell can't locate the object. This means you might find a type of object farther away if the nearest one is behind lead or running water.

Heightened (5th) You can target a specific creature or ancestry instead of an object, but you must have met or seen up close the creature or ancestry you want to target.

Mind Reading.name: Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Mirror Image.name: Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d4]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on [[/r 1d6]]).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}

Void Warp.name: Void Warp
Void Warp.description:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the level of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Telekinetic Hand.name: Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Message.name: Message
Message.description:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the level of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Planar Fast Healing.name: Planar Fast Healing
Planar Fast Healing.description:
A denizen of Leng maintains a connection to Leng at all times, and when away from Leng, they have fast healing 5. They lose this ability on Leng or in areas where planar connections do not function. If killed, their body dissolves into nothingness in [[/br 1d4 #Dissolve Body]]{1d4 rounds}, leaving behind their equipment. A slain denizen reforms in Leng; they can be permanently killed only when their planar fast healing doesn't function.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FastHealing]

No Breath.name: No Breath
No Breath.description: Denizens of Leng don't need to breathe.

Debilitating Bite.name: Debilitating Bite
Debilitating Bite.description: A creature that takes damage from a denizen's bite must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. Each time a target fails an additional save against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of Clumsy 4). This condition value decreases by 1 every 24 hours.

Leng Ruby.name: Leng Ruby
Leng Ruby.description: Many denizens of Leng carry strange rubies mined from quarries in Leng. As long as a creature holds a Leng ruby that it willingly accepted as a gift or payment from a denizen of Leng, any denizen of Leng can target that creature with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{Outcast's Curse}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]{Phantom Pain}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} at a range of 1 mile, and the bearer uses an outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its saving throw against Outcast's Curse.

Gravity Well.name: Gravity Well
Gravity Well.description:
You create a sphere of altered gravity. All creatures and unsecured objects in the area move towards the center, depending on their Reflex saving throws. This follows the rules for forced movement. If there's not enough space near the center of the sphere, creatures and objects nearer to the center move first, and others move as far as they can without being blocked, up to the amount set by their saving throw outcomes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature moves 5 feet toward the center.

Failure The creature moves 15 feet toward the center.

Critical Failure The creature moves 30 feet toward the center.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Whispers of the Void.name: Whispers of the Void
Whispers of the Void.description:
You whisper baleful secrets that transcend language and carry magically to the ears of your foes. The words take physical form, weakening the life force of the targets, each of which must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Heightened (+2) The persistent void damage increases by 1d8 on a success, or by 2d8 on a failure or critical failure.

Rouse Skeletons.name: Rouse Skeletons
Rouse Skeletons.description:
Misshapen skeletal forms erupt from a solid surface, such as a stone floor, and fill the burst. The area they fill is difficult terrain. Their grasping claws deal 2d6 slashing damage to creatures on the ground in the area when the skeletons first appear with a basic Reflex save.

On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can move the area of skeletons up to 20 feet within the range of the spell and deal 2d6 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save to each creature in the new area.

Damaging or destroying the skeletons is irrelevant, as new bones pull forth from the ground to repair and replace any that are obliterated.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Your Fear Gets Me High.name: Your Fear Gets Me High
Your Fear Gets Me High.description:
As long as he exerts full control over Dorianna, Ysondkhelir gains the following abilities:

  • He is Huge, instead of his normal size, with a reach of 15 feet on melee attacks.

  • He has damage resistance 10 (physical).

  • He gains the Spawn Hand action.

  • He is Quickened. He can only use the extra action granted by the Quickened condition to Cast a Spell or to Spawn Hand.

You're In My Nightmare.name: You're In My Nightmare
You're In My Nightmare.description:
As long as Ysondkhelir is alive, any square of his dreamworld that lacks a solid floor is considered to be a nightmare space. A character who enters or ends their turn in a nightmare space triggers the effect below, as the dream-catcher's malevolent nightmares tear into their mind.

@Check[type:will|dc:26|showDC:all]{basic Will save}

@Damage[(2d10+13)[spirit,mental]]{2d10+13 spirit and mental damage}

Critical success No damage. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success Half damage. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Failure Full damage. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

Critical failure Double damage. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 4}.

Spawn Hand.name: Spawn Hand
Spawn Hand.description: Ysondkhelir spawns a giant crawling hand in an unoccupied space within 30 feet.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Slither.name: Slither
Slither.description:
A mass of snakes made of shadow rise up to capture creatures in the area. Each creature in the area when you Cast the Spell takes @Damage[3d6[piercing]] damage and @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] damage from a biting snake, and it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} depending on its Reflex save. A creature that ends its turn in the area must also attempt this save, even if it's already grabbed or restrained by the snakes. You can Dismiss the spell.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is grabbed by a snake. The snakes' @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a snake to release the creature. A snake's AC is equal to your spell DC, and it's destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage at once. New snakes continually regrow as long as the spell lasts, so destroying snakes doesn't prevent slither from capturing more creatures.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is restrained by a snake.

Heightened (+2) The persistent poison damage increases by 1d6 and snake HP increases by 6.

Synesthesia.name: Synesthesia
Synesthesia.description:
The target's senses are suddenly rewired in unexpected ways, causing them to process noises as bursts of color, smells as sounds, and so on. This has three effects, and the target must attempt a Will save.

  • Due to the distraction, the target must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] each time it uses a concentrate action, or the action fails and is wasted.
  • The target's difficulty processing visual input makes all creatures and objects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from it.

  • The creature has trouble moving, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3} and giving it a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is affected for 1 round.

Failure The target is affected for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} as it attempts to process the sensory shifts.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to five creatures.

Attack of Opportunity (Special).name: Attack of Opportunity (Special)
Attack of Opportunity (Special).description:

Effect: Ysondkhelir's Control.name: Effect: Ysondkhelir's Control
Effect: Ysondkhelir's Control.description:
One success Ysondkhelir's resistance to physical damage drops to 5. The south section of his window wall disappears.

Two successes No more crawling hands can spawn. The north section of Ysondkhelir's window wall disappears.

Three successes Ysondkhelir is no longer quickened. The remaining sections of his window wall disappear.

Four successes Ysondkhelir loses his Attack of Opportunity and his resistance to physical damage. He also reverts to his normal size and loses 15 feet reach on melee strikes. Dorianna is temporarily free of his mental influence, though he will eventually reassert control if left alive.

Quickened.name: Quickened
Quickened.description: You're able to act more quickly. You gain 1 additional action at the start of your turn each round. Many effects that make you quickened require you use this extra action only in certain ways. If you become quickened from multiple sources, you can use the extra action you've been granted for any single action allowed by any of the effects that made you quickened. Because quickened has its effect at the start of your turn, you don't immediately gain actions if you become quickened during your turn.
